evidence: A held-out target has no training target-disease edges and therefore a zero SVD factor row.
observation: A held-out target has no training target-disease edges and therefore a zero SVD factor row; averaging its PPI neighbours' factors (beta 1.0) gave 0.320883/0.366264 on degree-matched cold start. That beats the base histogram 0.287942/0.313606 and the unsmoothed SVD 0.204616/0.207471; F-0041 keeps PPI smoothing with the base model as fallback.
subject: F-48
title: PPI-neighbour smoothing adapts the SVD to cold targets
